name: Tamasha
overview: Tamasha is Pakistan's boldest celebrity reality show, where drama, strategy, and raw emotions collide inside a sealed house. A group of diverse celebrities from across the entertainment world live together for weeks-completely cut off from the outside world. Under constant surveillance, they face daily challenges, personal conflicts, and power struggles. As alliances shift and secrets unravel, only one housemate can survive the drama to claim the ultimate title. In this house, every move is a performance-and every moment is Tamasha.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Tamasha (2022) is a Pakistani reality television show, similar to Big Brother, where celebrities and individuals from various backgrounds are confined to a house, known as the "Tamasha Ghar," with no contact with the outside world. Contestants must live together, facing challenges and tasks, with the ultimate goal of winning the game and a prize. The show features 24/7 surveillance, and eliminations occur through viewers' votes.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Tamasha Season 2 follows 14 contestants as they live in a mansion without phones or internet for 50 days, facing challenges and eliminations decided by viewers and the host, Adnan Siddiqui, all under 24/7 surveillance.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Tamasha Season 3 is a Pakistani reality TV show where contestants live together in a jungle-like area, participating in tasks and games. The show features a dynamic where participants endure the challenges of living with strangers for an extended period, facing potential conflicts, jail time for not following rules, and psychological strain.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Contestants from various walks of life are locked in a specially designed house, cut off from the outside world. Over several weeks, they live together, perform tasks, face nominations, and experience evictions until one contestant emerges as the winner with the largest cash prize yet.
